drafts.video_tip: Ride EHuanglu's two-day streak (355K then 166K): one personal, provocative line, the video does the talking. 15-20s: raw plate, AI comp pass, final shot, hard cuts on beat. Show only a workflow you really use (Firefly + Kling/Runway).

drafts.draft_en:
I drew a 6-panel storyboard on paper.

MAGI-2 turned it into this shot.

Sketch vs final, side by side 👇
drafts.video_tip: Split screen: hand-drawn storyboard panel left, MAGI-2 output right, synced timing. It's the format outsiders are flooding today, so win on VFX polish: add a Topaz upscale pass and a real camera move.

techhalla's 'One Piece but it's 1977' hit 45.3K: big IP + era restyle. Use your own House of David-style scene, 70s film grain, anamorphic flares, faded Kodachrome palette, 15s trailer cut. Only use footage/IP you have the rights to show.
